item.title: Outside entrance to communal gardens Oxford Road / opposite St Augustine School, 28th July
item.description:
This is a recurring fly-tipping location. The image shows several bags of rubbish that have been deliberately left behind by inconsiderate individuals. The Council should enforce fines where possible, and the installation of a CCTV camera would act as a strong deterrent. More broadly, Oxford Road would benefit from a thorough sweep and removal of litter, and the side streets should also be cleaned regularly to help maintain a safe and attractive environment for residents.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Oxford Road, London
